chain.title: Bootstrap with an explosion
chain.desc: Use the documented explosion recipe to turn iron into compressed iron, accepting its initial loss. Later, a working Pressure Chamber provides the controlled production route.

chain.title: Give compressed air a route
chain.desc: Craft Pressure Tubes to connect compressors and machines. Monitor pressure and add appropriate control; overpressure can destroy pneumatic equipment.

chain.title: Generate the first pressure
chain.desc: Fuel an Air Compressor and connect it to the air network. Use pressure monitoring and redstone control so it does not continue charging beyond the connected equipment's limit.

chain.title: Plan the pressure chamber
chain.desc: Craft chamber walls and consult the manual's hollow multiblock layout. Leave positions for a valve and item interfaces before sealing the structure.

chain.title: Connect air to the chamber
chain.desc: Include a Pressure Chamber Valve in the valid shell and connect the compressor. Confirm the chamber forms and read its pressure before attempting recipes.

chain.title: Move items without opening the shell
chain.desc: Install interfaces and configure input and output behavior. The completed chamber should accept ingredients and release results without repeatedly breaking its walls.

chain.title: Charge portable pneumatic tools
chain.desc: Connect a Charging Station to the air supply. Charge tools to a suitable pressure and check the installed pressure limits before taking them into the field.

chain.title: A charged maintenance tool
chain.desc: Charge the Pneumatic Wrench, then use it to configure or pick up compatible machines. This utility branch helps rebuild the workshop without completing electronics first.

chain.title: Try a liquid-fuel supply
chain.desc: Feed a Liquid Compressor with a supported fuel and compare its pressure production with your demand. It is an alternative compressor path, not a prerequisite for plastic.

chain.title: Survey for oil
chain.desc: Use the Seismic Sensor according to its manual and interpret the explosion-based survey. Locate crude oil before building a refinery around an unreliable supply.

chain.title: Separate crude oil into products
chain.desc: Build the refinery with the required output stack and heat it to the operating temperature. Route the fractions separately; one blocked output can interrupt the production chain.

chain.title: Combine heat and pressure
chain.desc: Supply the plant with the temperature, pressure, fluid, and item required by the chosen recipe. Plastic can use oil-derived LPG or the renewable biodiesel route.

chain.title: Solidify the molten plastic
chain.desc: Produce molten plastic, then pour it into the world to solidify it, or use a chilled Heat Frame processing setup. Cooling machinery is an alternative method, not mandatory for the first sheet.

chain.title: Order the missing plans
chain.desc: Charge an Amadron Tablet and link the payment and delivery inventory or tank. Use its trades to obtain PCB Blueprints and later Assembly Programs.

chain.title: A blueprint for reliable electronics
chain.desc: Order a PCB Blueprint through Amadron. It supplies the required pattern for the UV Light Box rather than being a circuit board itself.

chain.title: Press the blank circuit boards
chain.desc: Use the Pressure Chamber recipe for Empty PCBs at the required pressure. Keep a batch for testing the exposure and etching line.

chain.title: Expose the circuit pattern
chain.desc: Power the UV Light Box with air and expose Empty PCBs. Longer exposure improves etching reliability; choose the threshold before automating batches.

chain.title: Prepare the etching bath
chain.desc: Make etching acid with the installed recipe and supply the Etching Tank. Route exposed boards into it and separate successful boards from recyclable failures.

chain.title: Collect a successfully etched board
chain.desc: Etch an exposed PCB into an Unassembled PCB. Later, an assembly laser offers another production route once that machinery and its program are available.

chain.title: Finish the board with components
chain.desc: Add the required capacitors and transistors to the Unassembled PCB. Their recipes also use the pressure and plastic infrastructure built earlier.

chain.title: A coordinated assembly line
chain.desc: Combine a controller, platform, import and export units, and the required drill or laser. Obtain the matching Assembly Program through Amadron, then test a complete production cycle.

chain.title: Build a programmable helper
chain.desc: Craft and charge a Drone. It needs a program and a defined work area before it can perform a useful task.

chain.title: Give the drone a precise job
chain.desc: Write a small program in the Programmer, transfer it to a Drone, and test it on a safe work area. Start with one hauling or farming task before adding more behaviors.

chain.title: Turn Forge Energy into pressure
chain.desc: Supply a Flux Compressor with Forge Energy and connect pressure-rated tubing. Reconfigure pressure control for the new source instead of assuming the old fuel cycle still protects the network.

chain.title: Connect the workshop to your inventory
chain.desc: Configure an Aerial Interface for remote player inventory and pneumatic support. Charge its network and test the relevant inventory or air-transfer behavior before depending on it away from base.

notes: Re-reviewed against cached 6.0.23+mc1.20.1 item assets, recipes, and Patchouli entries. Corrects plastic bootstrap: world placement solidifies molten plastic without a mandatory cooling machine. Amadron and PCB Blueprint now precede UV Light Box; complete chamber components precede electronics. Explicit branch dependencies replace the old list order.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
milestones: Parallel oil and renewable plastic routes
limits: Targets 6.0.23+mc1.20.1. Drone programs, armor upgrades, and all petrochemical fractions are outside this milestone guide.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
